subSection.text: Percentages for completion status were calculated based on the number of participants in the Safety Analysis Set.
Denominator for percentages was the ITT Analysis Set.

Age (in years{or specify unit}) was collected on date of Day 1 visit. [If age was not collected, age was derived using data of Day 1 visit if dose, date of [randomization] [enrollment] if not dosed, or the date of informed consent if not randomized.
a   OS (months) = (date of death or censoring – date of {randomization/first dose} + 1)/30.4375, and the 95% CI is derived using log-log transformation.
b   Hazard ratio and 95% CIs are calculated using the Cox proportional hazards model / statistical method.
c   P value for comparing the overall survival functions from the two treatment groups is from.
d   Duration of OS follow-up (months) = (date of death or censoring – date of randomization + 1)/30.4375.
TE = treatment-emergent; TEAE = treatment-emergent adverse event.
Adverse events were coded according to MedDRA Version {XX.X}.

Treatment-emergent events began on or after the study drug start date up to {XX} days {or study drug-specific therapeutic reach} after the date of the last dose of study drug [and prior to the day of initiation of subsequent anticancer/antiviral/etc therapy].

Severity grades were defined by [Gilead Grading Scale for Severity of Adverse Events and Laboratory Abnormalities][The CTCAE Version X][The DAIDS Version XX]. [Participants were counted only one based on their highest grade for each summary row.]
Death includes any death that occurred during the study. Percentages for TEAE Dose Limiting Toxicity was calculated based on the number of participants in the DLT Evaluable Set.
BIOSTAT NOTES: If not using the severity grading system, replace 'AE with Grade >= 3' with 'Severe AE' and delete severity grade footnote.

subSection.text: Individual Data and Summary Statistics of Plasma Concentration (ng/mL) at Protocol-Specified Sampling Times
BLQ = below the limit of quantitation; LLOQ = lower limit of quantitation; CI = confidence interval.
Values BLQ were treated as 0 for predose and postdose.
If > 1/3 of postdose values are BLQ at a time point, then the mean, StD, and %CV are not calculated at that time point.
LLQ was defined as 5.0 ng/mL for analyte GS-XXXX.
For each participant in PK analysis set, intensive serial PK sample collection (samples over 24-hr postdose) was performed at Day 1.
